inclusions.text: Private boat for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private boat trip, operated for your party alone — never shared.
The boat is crewed for navigation, safety, and site selection, snorkelling equipment is provided, and one bottle of mineral water per person is included.

inclusions.text: Crew for navigation, safety, and site selection
inclusions.source: The boat is crewed for navigation, safety, and site selection, snorkelling equipment is provided, and one bottle of mineral water per person is included.

inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned vehicle from hotel to marina
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle collects your group and drives directly to the marina, bypassing the staging area where group tours assemble.
The return journey brings you back to the marina by late afternoon, and the private transfer drops you at your hotel.
Light refreshments and beverages are served onboard between sites.

It is suitable for children who can swim confidently — under-18s are welcome with a parent or guardian, and the crew carries life jackets; it is not suitable for non-swimmers, since this is open water.
